task_description: On Google Maps, find the current opening hours for the British Museum.
final_answer: The British Museum is currently closed. Google Maps lists its hours as: Monday–Thursday 10:00 am–5:00 pm, Friday 10:00 am–8:30 pm, Saturday–Sunday 10:00 am–5:00 pm.
